newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices firm in central U.S..
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices firm in central U.S..

text.p: Cash millfeed prices were slightly higher in the Midwest and Plains, while they were weaker in some east and west coast markets, cash dealers said.
Texas sources said millfeed was arriving into that market from the Midwest and southeast.
"We are buying feed from everywhere," a Texas source said.
Several dealers reported increased trading for spring and summer positions. They speculated the lower prices for those positions may have encouraged buying.
In the northeast, demand continued to be light. Buffalo dealers said offers for prompt shipped goods had fallen $3 per ton since Thursday to $71.
